input_fields.name: topology_modifying_action
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `action_id`, `topology_effect`, and `operation_boundary`; topology_effect must describe the supplied action.

input_fields.name: affected_object_references
input_fields.description: Array of reference objects, each with required keys `reference_id`, `reference_kind`, and `selection_scope`, that may become stale.

result_fields.name: topology_refresh_declaration
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `action_id`, `affected_references`, `refresh_before_next_selection`, and `refresh_scope`; nullable when the common output envelope records unknown topology impact.

result_fields.name: invalidated_references
result_fields.description: Array of reference IDs marked unusable after the topology-changing action; it may be empty.

procedure: Classify the supplied action as topology-modifying and identify its boundary in the operation plan.
Enumerate the supplied references that may be stale after the action and mark them invalid beyond that boundary.
Declare re-enumeration or semantic re-selection before the next selection, with a conservative scope when impact is uncertain.
Return `topology_refresh_declaration` and `invalidated_references` as action data, using the common output envelope for status, provenance ownership, and unresolved topology impact.
rejection_rules: Reject a refresh point without an identified action or affected reference scope.
Do not preserve stale references, infer stable identity from numbering, or hide the refresh inside a later operation.
This operation declares a refresh boundary only; it must not perform the refresh or mutate geometry.
